Reduced motion initially leaves exact values and makes no animations or counting spans
All nine counters preserve a static spoken value while visual numbers animate
Counters restore exact decimal/thousands/suffix strings and stop scheduling after completion
Counters complete once and remain unchanged on repeated intersection events
Offscreen counters pause and resume from their current progress
Changing reduced motion mid-animation restores every exact number and cancels reveals
Hidden document pauses animations and counters; showing resumes to correct final values
Desktop ambient offsets reset completely on reduced motion and on narrow pointer mode
Repeated module loading does not duplicate observers or animation setup
Progress and menu selection remain bounded with exactly one current location
Combined app.js then motion.js: counters, tab entry, autoplay, helmet modal and shared reduced-motion preference remain compatible
